ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white central zones occupying approximately 70-75% of the visible surface, contrasted against low-intensity black/dark-grey peripheral borders and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions cover the interior of both lobes. Low-intensity black bordering is prominent on the outer edges and trailing margins. A distinct vertical dark streak is located on the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe. Light tan/yellowish mottling is visible across the lower interior white sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Lobe boundaries exhibit a jagged profile with varying pixel-amplitudes, particularly pronounced towards the distal tips where textures become more complex.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent vertical linear dark disruption (rake mark) on the left lobe. Multiple fainter, parallel vertical linear markings visible on the medial-right lobe surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The extreme jaggedness of the outer tips presents a distinct 'feathered' silhouette against the background, deviating from standard fluke morphology due to excessive accumulation or erosion.
